_comment: Descriptive JSON-shape schema for item definitions (weapons in data/items/weapon_database.json, armor in data/items/armor_database.json, plus stat potions and ability-grant items). A human-readable shape guide for validators/tooling, NOT a strict JSON-Schema document. The Rust omega-server is the numeric authority for item stats/effects in the live sim and the Go API (Postgres) is the authority for durable item ownership (inventory/equipment) — 'the client requests, the server decides'; item files are a client mirror and the server/API wins on disagreement. Governing GDD doc: docs/gdd/loot.md (proposed item-definition fields; STATUS: TBD/UNBUILT — no item system in code today), docs/gdd/BIOMES.md (tier mapping), data/balance/damage_formulas.json. Class bytes: 0 Zealot,1 VoidHunter,2 Engineer,3 PlagueSeer,4 Warrior,5 Rogue,6 Mage. TODO: promote to formal JSON-Schema once the loot system is built and the final item schema is co-designed with the CMS.

fields.name: string
fields.item_type: string — weapon | armor | consumable | ability_grant | etc.
fields.tier_requirement: int 1-7 — REQUIRED; min monster tier that can drop it
fields.biome_requirement: string|null — OPTIONAL single biome id restriction (null = any qualifying-tier biome)
fields.class_restriction: int[] — allowed class bytes (empty = all classes)
fields.affixes: string[] — affix ids rolled from data/items/affix_pool.json
fields.granted_ability_id: string|null — OPTIONAL ability/spell slotted into action-bar slots 1-4
fields.drop_weight: number — relative roll weight within its tier/biome pool

invariants: tier_requirement is REQUIRED; biome_requirement and class_restriction are OPTIONAL
loot is server-rolled on monster death; clients never roll drops
a parameterised granted ability is live-addable; a genuinely new ability behaviour needs a sim_core change + deploy
